description: SPM Primary Substation Polygons is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " SPM Primary Substation Polygons " data table presents information about the geographic areas supplied by primary substations within SPM. It also shows the proportion of sensors connected to LV feeders, expressed as a percentage within each area. The table includes the following details: Geographic point of each substation – the exact location coordinates. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Asset Data. Its keywords are SPM, LV, LV Monitors, GSP, Primary, Grid. The portal shows 2025-11-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
